κυβιτίζω.definition: nudge or poke with the elbow, Epich.213

κυδαίνω.definition: fut. Lyc.721, etc.: Ep. aor; delight or gladden by marks of honour, Od.14.438, cf. Il.23.793

κυδάνω.definition: = only pres. and impf., exalt; to be triumphant, 20.42

κυδωνᾶτον.definition: drink made from quinces, Aët.5.139; drug compounded of quinces, Paul.Aeg.7.11

κυκλίζω.definition: cause to revolve; intrans. in Act., revolve, Dam.Pr.23

κύκλωμα.definition: that which is rounded into a; drum, Id.Ba.124

κύκλωσις.definition: surrounding, enveloping, esp. in; way round, Plu.Flam.4

κυλικεῖον.definition: sideboard, stand for drinking-; carousal, Cratin.Jun.9

κυλίνδω.definition: Ep., Lyr., Trag., also Telecl.1.8; revolve in mind, Pi.N.4.40

κυλλαίνω.definition: = let them hang down; intr., halt, limp, metaph., Ph.Fr.58 H

κυλλόω.definition: crook, flex, Gal.18.637:—Pass., become club-footed and bandy-legged, Hp.Art.53: pf. part. ib.62

κυμαίνω.definition: fut. Xuthus ap.Arist.Ph.216b25: aor; metaph., of restless passion, swell, seethe, A.Th.443; Pi.P.4.158; with passion, Pl.Lg.930a; Ael.NA7.15; ib.15.9

κυματίας.definition: Ion. surging, billowy; Act., causing waves, stormy, Hdt.8.118

κυμινεύω.definition: strew with cummin, Orac. ap. Luc.Alex.25

κυνέω.definition: Ep. impf. Od.21.224: fut. E.Cyc.172; later poet. Babr.129.17: aor. v.l. in Arist.HA560b31; Poet. Ep. v. infr.:-kiss, Od.23.208; Il.24.478; . . Od.21.224: c. acc. pers. et partis, 16.15, cf. 19.417; . . 16.21; Ar.Nu.81…

κυνήγιον.definition: later form for hunt, chase; beast-hunt in the Amphitheatre, = Lat. venatio, CIG3847b8 , OGI533.7

κυνίσκος.definition: puppy, nickname of Zeuxidamus in; metaph., little Cynic, Luc.Pisc.45

κυοτοκία.definition: production of young, in birds, Alex.Aphr.Pr.2.68

κύπερος.definition: Ion. for Cyperus rotundus; turmeric, Curcuma longa, Dsc.1.5

κυπτάζω.definition: Frequentat. of keep stooping, go poking; abs., cower, D.C.49.30, 63.28

κύπτω.definition: fut. LXXPs.9.31 : aor. (v; hang the head from shame, Ar.Eq.1354, Th.930; or sorrow, Amphis30.6, Euphro1.27, or thought, Epicr.11.21, 23

κυρόω.definition: c. acc. et inf., decree or ordain that . . , Arist.Fr.593; of arguments or doctrines, confirm, establish, Phld.Po. Herc.1676.3; . . Id.Sign.7

κύτταρος.definition: cell of a honeycomb, Id.V.1111; pit in the receptacle of Nelumbium speciosum, Thphr.HP4.8.7

κυφαγωγὸς ἵππος.definition: a horse that goes with the neck arched, X.Eq.7.10

κυφογέρων.definition: old man bent with age, Steph.in Hp.2.276 D

κυφότης.definition: a being bent or humpbacked; rotundity, Ath.11.482e

κύφωμα.definition: hump on the back, Hp.Art.41 ; Ruf. ap. Orib.45.30.43

κύφων.definition: crooked piece of wood, bent; pillory, Cratin.115, cf. Ar.Pl.476, 606; Arist.Pol.1306b2; OGI483.177

κύω.definition: post-Hom. form of (aor. 1 in Ep., v. infr; in pres. and impf., of females, conceive, Orac. ap. cf. Ar.Fr.609, Pl.Lg.789e, etc.; Luc.DMeretr.2.1; Id.Gall.19: metaph., Thgn.39

κωδωνίζω.definition: try, prove by ringing, of money, Ar.Ra.723; Pass., to have one's name noised abroad, EM325.21

κωλίζω.definition: in Pass., to be arranged according to Olymp.Hist.p.463 D.; esp. of poetical works, to be arranged according to metrical Ar. Cod.Ven.Subscr

κωλοτομέω.definition: prop. cut off limbs: generally, cut or mow down, Epic. ap. Plu.2.377d

κωλύμη.definition: = for the purpose of hindering, Th.1.92; . . by these impediments, Id.4.63; a poetical word in Th., cf. D.H.Amm.2.3

κωλύω.definition: rarely c. part. pro inf., Id.7.25:—Pass., Th.1.26; with relat. clause, = D.4.15; . . J.BJ6.6.2

κωμάζω.definition: esp. celebrate a in honour of the victor at the games, Pi.O.9.4, etc.: c. acc. cogn., Id.N.11.28; E.HFl.c

κωμῳδέω.definition: treat after the manner of hence; generally, make fun of, ridicule, Lys.24.18

κωμῴδημα.definition: matter for comedy, laughter such as comedy produces, Pl.Lg.816d

κώνησις.definition: pitching: hence, daubing, f.l. for Arist.HA623b31

κωνίον.definition: or Dim. of small cone; small pine-cone, Posidon.3 J

κωνοειδής.definition: conical, Archim.Con.Sph.Praef; metaph., concise, pointed, Corn.Rh.p.387 H

κωπέω.definition: or furnish with oars, in pf. Pass; furnish with handles, BGU1143.15

κωπηλατέω.definition: pull an oar, row, opp; metaph., of any similar motion forwards and backwards, as of a carpenter using an auger, E.Cyc.461

καθάπαν.definition: Adv. on the whole; better divisim cf. LXX2 Ma.15.30

κατοψέ.definition: Adv., strengthd. for late at night, Alex. Trall.2

κηρόθι.definition: Adv., with all the heart, heartily, in Hom. always folld. by Il.9.300; 21.136, cf. Od.5.284, etc.; 15.370; Hes.Sc.85

κλισίηθεν.definition: Adv. out of or from the hut, Il.1.391, etc

κλισίηνδε.definition: Adv. into or to the hut, ib.185

κρύβδα.definition: Adv., without the knowledge of, c; abs., secretly, Pi.P.4.114

κρύφα.definition: Adv., = without the; abs., secretly, Aen.Tact.2.4; by ballot, Th.4.88; obscurely, Plu.2.1125e

κρυφῇ.definition: Adv. secretly, in secret, S.Ant.85, 291, 1254, X.Smp.5.8, etc.:—Dor. ; also LXXJd.4.21, 9.31

κύβδα.definition: Adv., with the head forwards, stooping forwards, sens. obsc., Archil.32, cf. Ar.Eq.365, Th.489, S.Ichn.122

κυρίως.definition: Adv. of like a lord or master, with; surely, by fixed decree, A.Ch.785

κατεπάγω.definition: bring down upon, Plu.2.551d : is f.l. for in Ar.Eq.25

καμψίπους.definition: gen. bending the foot, in running, i.e. swift-running, A.Th.791

καπυρόομαι.definition: Pass., become dry or parched, Id.4.4.1; become crackly, Orib.Fr.74

καρπολόγος.definition: gathering fruit; title of magistrates at Thasos, BCH45.147

κενολογέω.definition: talk emptily, Eup.418, Arist.Rh.1393a17; Procl.in Prm.p.845 S

κυδιάνειρα.definition: fem.Adj. bringing men; Pass., glorified by men, famous for men, APl.1.1

κερεαλκής.definition: stout in the horns, A.R.4.468; v.l. for in Call.Dian.179

κατασθενέω.definition: to be or grow weak; later causal, weaken, App.Anth.3.158

καλίγιον.definition: Dim. of Lat. caliga, boot, PSI8.886 , Anon.in Rh.123.21; written Aët.7.101

καθέσιμον.definition: fee for attendance at the IG22.956.14, al

καθημερόω.definition: soften, tranquillize, Porph.VP32:—Med., smooth down, v.l. in Ps.-Callisth.1.1:—Pass., Hierocl.p.59A

κρατήρ.definition: metaph., of the messenger who bears an ode, Pi.O.6.91; of a sycophant, Ar.Ach.937 ; . . A.Ag.1397; of civil war, D.H.7.44

κυματωγή.definition: place where the waves break, beach, Hdt.4.196,9.100, Luc.Herm.84, etc.: in pl., Democr.164

κερματίζω.definition: cut into pieces, chop up, Pl.R.525e; coin into money, AP11.271

κρήνηνδε.definition: Adv.to a well or spring, Od.20.154

κάστωρ.definition: beaver, Castor fiber, Hdt.4.109; = Hp.Mul.2.157, Aret.CA2.10

κατάπυρος.definition: very red, deep red, Dsc.5.77; f.l. for Id.2.154

καταπάτημα.definition: that which is trampled under foot, LXXLa.2.8, al

κυκεών.definition: acc. Hp.Acut.39, Pl.R.408b; metaph., mixture, medley, Luc.Vit.Auct.14, Icar.17

κρημνόγραφος.definition: written in rugged style, uncouth, Tz.ad Hes.Op.p.9 G

κατουρέω.definition: make water upon, Ar.Ec.832: abs., make water, Arist.HA556b15, Luc.Merc.Cond.34

κώφωσις.definition: Ion. = foreg., Id.Aph.4.28; metaph., dullness, Pempel. ap. Stob.4.25.52

κνίδωσις.definition: itching, such as is caused by a nettle, Hp.Prorrh.2.30

κακόδουλος.definition: ill-treating one's slaves, Cratin.81; bad slave, Ps.-Luc.Philopatr.7

κήλησις.definition: bewitching, charming, Pl.Euthd.290a: enchantment by eloquence, ibid.; by music and sweet sounds, Id.R.601b, Stoic.3.97

καθευρίσκω.definition: discover, Luc.Ocyp.68:—Pass., she was found in the act of adorning . . , S.Ant.395

κυφοειδής.definition: of the nature or quality of Androm. ap. Gal.13.198, Archig. ap.Aët.16.88

κηλωνεύω.definition: suspend on a fulcrum or pivot, HeroSpir.1.20 :—Pass., Ath.Mech.29.14, 30.4

κακοήθεια.definition: Ion. bad disposition; bad manners or habits, X.Cyn.13.16

κλώψ.definition: thief, Hdt.1.41, al., E.Hel.553, X.An.4.6.17, Aen.Tact.23.7, etc

κυριεύω.definition: to be lord or master of; Astrol., of planets, Ptol.Tetr.169, cf. Vett.Val.63.23:—Pass., Ptol.Tetr.112

κλητέος.definition: to be called, named; one must call, ib.470d, LXXEp.Je.63, Max. Tyr.40.5, Iamb.Myst.3.9

καμμονίη.definition: Ep. for steadfastness, endurance , steady courage, Il.22.257, cf. 23.661, APl.4.221.4

κροκόμαγμα.definition: residuum after the saffron-; a compound drug, Damocr. ap. Gal.14.133, Paul. Aeg.7.12

κατωμαδόν.definition: Adv., from the shoulders; on or hanging from the shoulders, A.R.2.679; BCH50.529

κάθυδρος.definition: very watery, full of water, S.OC158 ; v.l. in Plb.5.24.4

καρχήσιος.definition: in pl., halyards of a ship, Gal.19.109; cords used in surgical operations, Id.18.351, 522

καλαμηφορέω.definition: bring a corn-token in order to receive a ration of corn , Them.Or.23.292a

κολλοπόω.definition: glue together, because glue was boiled out of II.2, Achae.22, EM323.22

κατασπάω.definition: fut. pf. Ar.Eq.718:—draw; gather fruit from, prob. in PSI1.33.26

κυκλογράφος.definition: writing on a cycle of subjects, of Dionysius Scytobrachion, Procl. ad Hes.p.6 G., Tz.H.12.184

κορώνεως.definition: a fig of raven-grey colour, Ar.Pax628

καταλεαίνω.definition: fut. LXXDa.7.23:—grind down; smooth down, placate, Just.Nov.129Praef

κλότιον.definition: or a kind of vessel or basket, PSI4.428.2, cf. 51

κροταφίζω.definition: strike on the temples, PLips.40 iii 24

κατακάμπτω.definition: bend down, so as to be concave; cover with a vault, Str.5.3.8

κογχοειδής.definition: of the mussel kind, Str.3.2.7; Subst. , Geom., conchoid curve, Nicomedes ap. Procl.in Euc.p.272 F. Adv. in the form of a shell, Chor.p.86 B

κληρουχέω.definition: obtain by allotment, esp. of conquered; inherit, Sm.Ps.81.8

κάπνισμα.definition: offering of smoke, i.e. incense, AP9.174.5

καταγωγίς.definition: winding-mechanism of a torsion-; curved end of a stomach-bow , HeroBel.78.3

κορυζάω.definition: have a catarrh, run at the nose, Pl.R.343a; metaph., drivel, Plb.38.12.5, cf. Phld.D.1.11

κυανανθής.definition: of dark hue, of the sea, B.12.124

καρπισμός.definition: profit, Arist.Pr.952b6; and = Lat. vindiciae, Gloss

καταβάρησις.definition: weighing down, oppression; mob violence, Rev.Ét.Gr.19.234

κατερευνάω.definition: lay bare, uncover, LXXJe.29.10 ; = dīrīmat, Gloss

κεντροθεσία.definition: arrangement of heavenly bodies on cardinal points, Vett.Val.226.33

κυρτίς.definition: weel, lobster-pot, Opp.H.5.600; strainer, Nic.Al.493, Dsc.1.52, Gal.13.55

κοσμουργός.definition: creator of the world, Iamb.in Nic.p.10 P., Dam.Pr.270

κνῆστρον.definition: stinging plant, Daphne oleoides, Hp.Mul.1.80, 2.169 ; = Dsc.4.172

κατάδρυμμα.definition: tearing, rending, . . of flesh with hands, E.Supp.51

κυαμίζω.definition: to be ripe for marriage , Ar.Fr.582

κατάψευσμα.definition: false accusation, Metrod.Fr.18: generally, fiction, falsity, Arr.Epict.2.20.23

κατακτυπέω.definition: make a loud noise, roar against, Alciphr.1.23

κάμμορος.definition: Ep. for subject to destiny, i.e. ill-fated , Od.11.216, cf. 2.351, 5.160, A.R.4.1318

κίβισις.definition: Cypr. for , pouch, wallet, such as Perseus wore, Hes.Sc.224, Pherecyd.11 J., Call.Fr.177

καύλινος.definition: made of a stalk or stick, Luc.VH1.16

κορίαξος.definition: a kind of fish, Alex.Trall.1.12, al

κλωβίον.definition: Dim. of sq., small cage, Eust.ad D.P.1134, Hdn.Epim.72

καρώ.definition: caraway, Dsc.3.57, Orib.3.2.3: perh. to be read in Ath.9.371e

καλλίστευμα.definition: offering of what is most; second prize for beauty, Lyc.1011

καταπειλέω.definition: strengthd. for use threatening words, S.OC659; by the threats uttered, ib.1147

κοκκυσμός.definition: crying cuckoo: in men, the sound of a very high voice, Nicom.Harm.11.1, Exc.4

κακοοινία.definition: bad quality of wine, opp. Gp.5.43 tit

κυαμόβολος.definition: chosen by beans, i.e. by lot , voting with the bean), S.Fr.288

κένωσις.definition: emptying, depletion; Medic., evacuation, Hp.Aph.2.8, interpol.in Dsc.2.50; opp. Gal.18.134

κρυπτεία.definition: secret service at Sparta; hiding-place, Agath.5.19

κακοφωνέω.definition: speak ill, opp. prob. in Phld.Rh.1.176 S

καρυΐτης.definition: like a nut, Euphorbia Myrsinites, Dsc.4.164

κατευτονέω.definition: strengthd. for have the power to; abs., to be finely tempered, Ph.Bel.71.24

κοχλάζω.definition: = Plu.2.590f , Gloss.: aor. subj. of boiling water, PHolm.3.1

κάλτιος.definition: Sicil. form of Lat. calceus, shoe, Rhinth.5, Plu.Aem.5, 2.813e, Plb.30.18.3 Gloss

καλοφόρος.definition: wood-carrier, one of a soldier's attendants, Dosiad.Hist.1

καταθήκη.definition: deposit, prob. f.l. for in Lys.Fr.70 tit., Isoc.17.27

κιναιδίας.definition: stone found in head of II, Plin.HN37.153

κολοβανθής.definition: bearing stunted flowers, such as peas, Thphr.HP8.3.3:—also ib.6.5.3

κακελκής.definition: suffering from malignant ulcer, Hp.Aff.20; cf

καμάκινος.definition: made of reed or cane, opp. X.Eq.12.12

κρύφω.definition: late form of only impf., Q.S.1.393, AP7.700 , Nonn.D.7.45, al

κρήνηθεν.definition: Adv. from a well or spring, AP15.25.18

κόγχη.definition: mussel or cockle, Emp.76.1; shell-full, a small measure of capacity, Pherecr.143.3, Hp.Nat.Mul.32, Morb.3.15, Thphr.HP9.6.2

κορακοειδής.definition: like a raven, of raven kind; like a crow's beak, Gal.UP13.12, cf. eund.2.275

καρπύλη.definition: an Indian plant, Clitopho ap. Stob.4.36.22

κλοῦστρον.definition: a kind of cake, Chrysipp. Tyan. ap. Ath.14.647d

κακοκαρπία.definition: bearing bad or imperfect fruit, Thphr.HP1.4.1, al

κυκλόσε.definition: Adv., in or into a circle, Il.4.212; stretch [the skin] outwards on all sides, 17.392, cf. Onos.17, A.D.Adv.193.8, Ael.NA3.13, etc

κατακελεύω.definition: command silence, Ar.Av.1273: generally; of the boatswain, give the time in rowing, Ar.Ra.207

κήρυξις.definition: proclaiming, as a subject of competition, D.C.63.8, 14

καυσόω.definition: heat, Ptol.Tetr.18:—Pass., burn with intense; suffer from I, Antyll. ap. Orib.9.13.1, Gal.15.720; Dsc.2.134

καλινδήθρα.definition: = place for horses to roll after exercise, Ael.NA3.2

κοσμοποιία.definition: creation, Arist.Metaph.985a19; title of a work by Empedocles, Arist.Ph.196a22; applied to the opening chapters of Genesis, Ph. l.c

κατασποδέω.definition: throw down in the dust, make to bite the dust, Ar.Th.560; A.Th.809

κατακομιδή.definition: bringing down to the sea-shore for; bringing home, D.S.18.3

καλλιστεῖον.definition: offering of what is; beauty prize, of the apple of Paris, Luc.DDeor.20.1

καθιμάω.definition: let down by a rope, Ar.V.379, 396; Arist.Mech.857b4; . . of the heron, Babr.94.3:— Pass., D.C.45.2

καταιθύσσω.definition: wave or float down, . . Pi.P.4.83; sheds fair weather down upon the hearth, ib.5.11:—hence Trag.Adesp. 216

κρίμα.definition: decision, judgement; decree, resolution, D.H.4.12; BCH27.107, cf. IGRom.3.58,66

κατανίπτης.definition: washer: at Athens, he who washed the peplos of Athena Polias, AB269, EM494.25

κρεανόμος.definition: one who distributes the flesh of victims, E.Cyc.245: as Adj., mangling, Lyc.203, cf. 762

κρωσσός.definition: water-pail, pitcher, mostly in pl., A.Fr.96; cinerary urn, Erinn.5, cf. Mosch.4.34: also fem., . . Epigr.Gr.697a

κακάγγελτος.definition: caused by ill tidings, the sorrow of ill tidings, S.Ant.1286

κλοιόπους.definition: clog for the foot, in pl., = Tz.H.13.300

κασαλβάζω.definition: behave like a strumpet, Hermipp.Com.71; c. acc., abuse them in strumpet fashion, Ar.Eq.355

κιρκίας.definition: = cj. for in Arist.Mu.394b31 and for in Id.Vent.973b20

κόττος.definition: = prob. in Ezek.Exag.261, cf; a river-fish, Arist.HA534a1

κορυφαία.definition: head-stall of a bridle, X.Eq.3.2, 5.1; tuft on the crown of the head, Luc.Lex.5, Eust.1528.18

κεφαλαιόω.definition: bring under heads, sum up, Th.3.67; smite on the head, Ev.Marc.12.4

κοτυλιστής.definition: one who plays the game Jul.Mis.360a

κεναγγία.definition: Ion. , emptiness of vessels; esp. hunger, Pl.Com.156; to fast, Ar.Fr.608

κατακυκάω.definition: beat up, as white of egg in water, Hp.Morb.3.17

καταλάμπω.definition: shine upon or over, c. gen; abs., shine, of the sun, Hp.Aër.5, E.El.464 , v.l. in h.Merc.141

κερατόφωνος.definition: sounding with the horn, of the struck by the plectrum, Telest.4

κήρινθος.definition: bee-bread, = Arist.HA623b23; kind of ulcer, Id

καλεσίχορος.definition: only in Ep. form calling forth the dance, calling to the dance, Orph.L.718

κεντηνάριον.definition: weight of 100 lbs., Edict.Diocl.18.5, Olymp.Hist.p.469D., Men.Prot.p.100 D

κώλυμα.definition: defence against a thing, Th.7.53: c. gen., Hdn.1.17.10

κατεμέω.definition: aor. 1 vomit, be sick over, Ar.Fr.152, Ael.NA4.36, Luc.Sat.38

κυλίνδησις.definition: rolling, wallowing; metaph., constant practice, skill, Pl.Sph.268a

καταγραφή.definition: drawing, delineation; delineation in profile, in bas-relief, Pl.Smp.193a

καθυστερικῶς.definition: Adv. behind their time, Ptol.Phas.p.11 H

κάτοινος.definition: drunken with wine, E.Ion553; addicted to wine, D.S.5.26

κακοζηλία.definition: unhappy imitation or rivalry, v.l. for; Rhet., of style, affectation, Luc.Salt.82, Demetr.Eloc.189

καταπισσόω.definition: Att. cover with pitch, as was; tar and burn , Heraclid. Pont. ap. Ath.12.524a:—Pass., Pl.Grg.473c

καμινόθεν.definition: Adv. from a furnace, Nic.Th.707, Call.Dian.60

κοτυλήρυτος.definition: that can be drawn in cups; a measure of vinegar, Nic.Th.539

κρίμνον.definition: coarse barley meal, Hp. ap. Gal.19.115; coarse loaf, AP6.302 , Babr.108.9

κρεοκοπέω.definition: cut up like meat: hence, hack in pieces, A.Pers.463; E.Cyc.359

καταλλάσσω.definition: Att. change money; abs., transgress, contravene regulations, IG5.3.2

κωνειάζομαι.definition: Pass., to be dosed with hemlock, Str.10.5.6: title of a play by Menander

καταφύξιμος.definition: to which one can fly for refuge, Plu.2.290c

κλυδάζομαι.definition: fluctuate, of the fluid in pleurisy, Hp.Loc.Hom.14; of cranes flying, Max.Tyr.12.3

κυρτοειδής.definition: Astrol., of signs under which; of the moon, = Paul. Al.G.4

κατεξετάζω.definition: decide, try, Cod.Just.1.4.29 Intr.; examine carefully, Agath.5.9

κοσμοφόρος.definition: one who carries ornaments in; Archit., ornamental frieze, Rev.Phil.44.251

κατακοπή.definition: cutting back, pruning, Thphr.CP2.12.6 ; cutting in pieces, Theopomp.Hist.283a; Artem.1.50

κρημνηγορέω.definition: speak rugged words, Tz.ad Hes.Op.p.10 G

καθομηρίζω.definition: describe Homerically, Aristaenet.1.3, 12; intr., speak in the style of Homer, Eustr.in EN268.33

κύκηθρον.definition: ladle for stirring: metaph., turbulent fellow, agitator, Ar.Pax654; J.AJ17.5.8, cf. Cels. ap. OrigenesCels.5.63

καινοτόμος.definition: innovating, . . . . are marked by cleverness and novelty, Arist.Pol.1265a12; of persons, Hermog.Inv.3.5: metaph., ibid

κατασοβέω.definition: frighten away, scare, Arist.Mir.841b22; drive down, Parth.14.3

καύκαλον.definition: part of a military boot, Anon.in Rh.123.22

κάλπιον.definition: Dim. of foreg. , Pamphil. ap. Ath.11.475c

καταξιόω.definition: deem worthy, c. acc. et inf., D.59.111; hold; command, bid, A.Ag.572; thou didst decree it so, S.Ph.1095

καλαμηδόν.definition: Adv. like a broken reed, of a kind of fracture, Sor.Fract.10, Paul.Aeg.6.89

κορώνισμα.definition: crow-song, a begging-song sung by strollers, Hagnocles ap.Ath.8.360b

καλλώπισμα.definition: ornament of speech, D.H.Th.46; metaph., fair show, pretence, Pl.Grg.492c

καταγγέλλω.definition: announce, proclaim, declare; recite, recount, Luc.Par.39

καλλιμάρτυς.definition: one who gives good evidence, Hdn.Epim.186

κομιστέος.definition: to be gathered in; one must bring, Pl.R.413d

κωμόπολις.definition: village-town, i.e. a place not entitled to be called a Str.12.2.6, al., Ev.Marc.1.38

κυφόομαι.definition: Pass., have curvature of the spine, Hp.Art.41; ibid., cf. Gal.7.782

καταβυρσόω.definition: cover with hides, Th.7.65; sew up in a skin, Plu.Cleom.38

καταφοιτάω.definition: Ion. come down constantly or regularly, as wild beasts from the mountains to prey, Hdt.7.125

κήδευμα.definition: connexion or alliance by marriage, E.Med.76, Pl.Lg.773b. 2. poet. for one who is so connected, S.OT85, E.Or.477

κατά.definition: + gen.: giù da, contro; + acc.: secondo, per, lungo, riguardo a (κατὰ γῆν καὶ θάλατταν)

καίνυμαι.definition: superare, eccellere [epico]: pf. κέκασμαι (valore di presente): mi distinguo

κατέπεφνον.definition: uccisi [epico]: aor. II a raddoppiamento del tema φεν- (senza presente); inf. καταπεφνεῖν
